_comment: Colonnades: the walls of `edges` (OSM edge indices of the building) start `base` metres above the sidewalk and `soffit` (tool frame x, z) closes the underside of the overhang at that height. tool/src/buildings.dart (Arcade); the recessed ground floor is a building part in buildings.json and the columns are box features. `spans` {edge: [t0, t1]} opens only that part of a wall (the colonnade end beside a wall that stays on the ground). `arches` {edge, openings [[t0, t1]...], crown, walk [t0, t1], depth, thick, riser, soffitColor}: round arches cut into one edge (Nama on Ilica), heights in the picture's metres; the wall starts at its highest sidewalk and each bay of the walkway gets its own floor a riser above the pavement in front of it (Arches in tool/src/buildings.dart).

w97089760._source: Nama (Ilica 4): the open arcade of seven round arches on Ilica, measured on the facade picture (.art/facades/ilica_nama/raw.png, arches at x 78-187 ... 930-1037 of 1536, crowns at 6.82 m); Street View Jul 2024: one or two steps up into each arch, the walkway about 3 m deep
